summary: Documented the empty-args contract in three locations: (1) Command.run JSDoc in src/types.ts now states that interactive dispatch always calls run([]) and CLI flags are never forwarded; (2) showInteractiveMenu() JSDoc in src/menu/interactive.ts gained an 'Empty-args contract' paragraph explicitly naming cmd.run([]); (3) api-surface.md Command type section has an inline comment on the run field capturing the same contract. All 229 tests pass — no functional changes were made.

comments.note: No documentation gaps found. The empty-args contract was undocumented in all three target locations; all three are now updated and consistent.
